brief: v26.1 flagship: inside the scanned Cozy Neon Cyberpunk Ramen Bar, place a 1.2m-tall GREEN pillar on the floor via the OCCUPANCY-AWARE solver (meta.occupancyPath — the unlabeled counter slab blocks it, so it lands in genuinely free floor) and a MAGENTA pillar at the pose the label-blind solver would have chosen (48 occupied voxels — it impales the unlabeled counter). The pair makes the closed v24 finding LOOKable.

meta.brief: Occupancy-from-geometry flagship inside the scanned ramen bar: the occupancy-aware pillar stands clear of the UNLABELED counter; the blind pose impales it.

verificationPlan.claim: the GREEN occupancy-aware pillar stands on open floor near the far-right end of the bar (solver pose [0.761, 0.6, -3.011], 0 occupied voxels in its volume, 277 candidate cells rejected by unlabeled geometry) while the MAGENTA pillar at the label-blind pose [-0.114, 0.6, -1.436] visibly intersects the UNLABELED counter slab (48 occupied voxels) — inside the rendered ramen-bar mesh (seated y+0.776, y180)
